outcomes.description: The AI restocks inventory before performing the status transition, violating the requirement that the transition must happen first and must raise OrderError without calling restock if it fails.
outcomes.diff:
--- reference/shopcart/orders.py
+++ mutant/shopcart/orders.py
@@ -92,4 +92,4 @@
     def return_items(self, inventory: Inventory) -> None:
-        self._transition(OrderStatus.RETURNED)
         for sku, qty in self.items.items():
             inventory.restock(sku, qty)
+        self._transition(OrderStatus.RETURNED)

outcomes.description: The AI forgets to update the ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS map for RETURNED to REFUNDED, causing AC4 to fail even though the method is implemented.
outcomes.diff:
--- reference/shopcart/orders.py
+++ mutant/shopcart/orders.py
@@ -33,3 +33,3 @@
     OrderStatus.SHIPPED: {OrderStatus.RETURNED},
-    OrderStatus.RETURNED: {OrderStatus.REFUNDED},
+    OrderStatus.RETURNED: set(),
     OrderStatus.REFUNDED: set(),

outcomes.description: The AI uses inventory.release instead of inventory.restock in return_items, a plausible confusion of internal APIs since cancel() uses release().
outcomes.diff:
--- reference/shopcart/orders.py
+++ mutant/shopcart/orders.py
@@ -94,2 +94,2 @@
         for sku, qty in self.items.items():
-            inventory.restock(sku, qty)
+            inventory.release(sku, qty)

outcomes.description: The AI uses the wrong string value for the RETURNED enum member, using 'return' instead of 'returned', violating AC1.
